# Media Lab

> Reference library for content creation (short video, carousels, text posts, launch videos, thumbnails, event media): a brief-to-publish procedure, format specs, hook library, critique rubric and tested ffmpeg recipes. Packaged as a Claude Code plugin.

## Start
- [SKILL.md](plugins/media-lab/skills/media-lab/SKILL.md): procedure and hard rules
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to use and extend
